stories.title: No meeting date set for Burnham talks, First Minister confirms
stories.summary: Wales’ First Minister has said he has “a lot to talk about” with Andy Burnham if, as widely expected, he becomes Britain’s new Prime Minister this month. stories.title: Queensferry community group appeals for help finishing unfinished cabin after contractor disappeared
stories.summary: Ty Calon, a community facility on the Queensferry Campus, says a grant funded cabin project has been left unfinished after a contractor took payment and disappeared. stories.title: All the candidates for two Flintshire by-elections today
stories.summary: There are two by-elections happening this week to fill vacancies on Flintshire County Council. The first, in Connah’s Quay Central, follows the resignation of long-time Connah’s Quay councillor Bernie Attridge. stories.title: Pupils help clean up Ewloe as part of Mini Police scheme
stories.summary: Two large bin bags of rubbish, and a toaster, were pulled from a duck pond in Ewloe last week. Year 5 pupils from Ysgol Penarlag found the rubbish while taking part in North Wales Police’s Mini Police scheme. stories.title: Police warn against swimming and off road biking at Flintshire Quarry
stories.summary: North Wales Police has warned people to stay away from Pant Quarry in Halkyn, after a high number of calls about off road bikes and swimmers at the site.
